entities.summary: The Svealand Line is a railway line in Sweden, which runs between Södertälje and Valskog via Mariefred Läggesta, Strängnäs and Eskilstuna. The length is 115 kilometres (71 mi). The line is named after the historical Swedish central region of Svealand.
